record.one_liner: Ecommerce platform offering store catalog, orders, customers and storefront REST and GraphQL APIs
record.auth_notes: Store-level API account token sent as X-Auth-Token header (api_key). App-level API account client ID plus client secret used to decode a JWT for Current Customer (other). OAuth app flow was not verified in pages I fetched, so it is not listed.
record.access_notes: API accounts are created in the store control panel. I did not read a pricing or plan page, so plan gating is unverified; confidence on access is low.
record.api_notes: Separate REST Admin API, Storefront GraphQL API and Storefront REST API, plus B2B Edition REST API on api-b2b.bigcommerce.com.
record.blocker_notes: Self-serve store-level API tokens and documented REST API. Official Store Management MCP exists. Storefront MCP was described as Early Access in a vendor blog, so that surface may be gated.
